name: box_unround
note: A box with sides no binary fraction holds exactly.

name: box_thin
note: A box one side of which is twice OCCT's tolerance.
boundary: a side just above the 1e-7 length tolerance

name: cylinder_hair
note: A cylinder whose radius is twice OCCT's tolerance.
boundary: a radius just above the 1e-7 length tolerance

name: sphere_unround
note: A sphere with an unround radius.

name: sphere_kilometre
note: A sphere of the largest radius Silico takes.
boundary: a radius at the 1e6 length limit

name: cone_frustum_widening
note: A frustum wider at its top.

name: cone_almost_pointed
note: A frustum whose top radius is twice OCCT's tolerance.
boundary: a radius just above the 1e-7 length tolerance

name: torus_fat
note: A ring torus whose hole is small.

name: torus_horn
note: A horn torus: the tube touches the axis.
boundary: the minor radius equal to the major, the most Silico takes
